mapper.sql: tp.ticket_product_id, tp.place_id, tp.name, tp.status, tp.sale_start_at, tp.sale_end_at, tp.usage_start_date, tp.usage_end_date, p.name AS place_name, p.region, p.city, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ticket_product_options o WHERE o.ticket_product_id = tp.ticket_product_id AND o.is_active = TRUE) AS option_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ticket_product_options o JOIN ticket_time_slots s ON s.ticket_product_option_id = o.ticket_product_option_id WHERE o.ticket_product_id = tp.ticket_product_id AND o.is_active = TRUE AND s.status = 'OPEN') AS slot_count, COALESCE((SELECT SUM(i.total_quantity) FROM ticket_product_options o JOIN ticket_time_slots s ON s.ticket_product_option_id = o.ticket_product_option_id JOIN ticket_inventory i ON i.ticket_time_slot_id = s.ticket_time_slot_id WHERE o.ticket_product_id = tp.ticket_product_id AND o.is_active = TRUE AND s.status = 'OPEN'), 0) AS total_quantity, COALESCE((SELECT SUM(i.reserved_quantity) FROM ticket_product_options o JOIN ticket_time_slots s ON s.ticket_product_option_id = o.ticket_product_option_id JOIN ticket_inventory i ON i.ticket_time_slot_id = s.ticket_time_slot_id WHERE o.ticket_product_id = tp.ticket_product_id AND o.is_active = TRUE AND s.status = 'OPEN'), 0) AS reserved_quantity, COALESCE((SELECT SUM(i.total_quantity - i.reserved_quantity) FROM ticket_product_options o JOIN ticket_time_slots s ON s.ticket_product_option_id = o.ticket_product_option_id JOIN ticket_inventory i ON i.ticket_time_slot_id = s.ticket_time_slot_id WHERE o.ticket_product_id = tp.ticket_product_id AND o.is_active = TRUE AND s.status = 'OPEN'), 0) AS remaining_quantity, (SELECT MIN(o.unit_price) FROM ticket_product_options o WHERE o.ticket_product_id = tp.ticket_product_id AND o.is_active = TRUE) AS min_unit_price, (SELECT MIN(o.currency_code) FROM ticket_product_options o WHERE o.ticket_product_id = tp.ticket_product_id AND o.is_active = TRUE) AS currency

sql.if: AND CONCAT_WS(' ', tp.name, p.name, p.region, p.city) ILIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%'

ORDER BY tp.sale_start_at DESC, tp.ticket_product_id DESC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ticket_products tp JOIN places p ON p.place_id = tp.place_id WHERE 1 = 1
SELECT FROM ticket_products tp JOIN places p ON p.place_id = tp.place_id WHERE tp.ticket_product_id = #{ticketProductId}

INSERT INTO ticket_products ( place_id, name, description, sale_start_at, sale_end_at, usage_start_date, usage_end_date, status ) VALUES ( #{placeId}, #{name}, #{description}, #{saleStartAt}, #{saleEndAt}, #{usageStartDate}, #{usageEndDate}, 'DRAFT' ) RETURNING ticket_product_id
mapper.update: UPDATE ticket_products SET place_id = #{request.placeId}, name = #{request.name}, description = #{request.description}, sale_start_at = #{request.saleStartAt}, sale_end_at = #{request.saleEndAt}, usage_start_date = #{request.usageStartDate}, usage_end_date = #{request.usageEndDate} WHERE ticket_product_id = #{ticketProductId}
mapper.select: SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM places WHERE place_id = #{placeId})
mapper.sql: s.ticket_time_slot_id, o.ticket_product_option_id, o.name AS option_name, o.unit_price, o.currency_code AS currency, o.is_active AS option_active, s.usage_date, s.start_time, s.end_time, s.status, i.total_quantity, i.reserved_quantity, (i.total_quantity - i.reserved_quantity) AS remaining_quantity
mapper.select: SELECT FROM ticket_time_slots s JOIN ticket_product_options o ON o.ticket_product_option_id = s.ticket_product_option_id JOIN ticket_inventory i ON i.ticket_time_slot_id = s.ticket_time_slot_id WHERE o.ticket_product_id = #{ticketProductId} ORDER BY s.usage_date, s.start_time NULLS FIRST, o.sort_order

SELECT FROM ticket_time_slots s JOIN ticket_product_options o ON o.ticket_product_option_id = s.ticket_product_option_id JOIN ticket_inventory i ON i.ticket_time_slot_id = s.ticket_time_slot_id WHERE s.ticket_time_slot_id = #{slotId} FOR UPDATE OF i
mapper.update: UPDATE ticket_inventory SET total_quantity = #{totalQuantity}, version = version + 1 WHERE ticket_time_slot_id = #{slotId} AND #{totalQuantity} >= reserved_quantity
mapper.sql: o.ticket_product_option_id, o.ticket_product_id, o.name, o.description, o.unit_price, o.currency_code AS currency, o.max_quantity_per_user, o.sort_order, o.is_active, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ticket_time_slots s WHERE s.ticket_product_option_id = o.ticket_product_option_id) AS slot_count
mapper.select: SELECT FROM ticket_product_options o WHERE o.ticket_product_id = #{ticketProductId} ORDER BY o.sort_order, o.ticket_product_option_id
mapper.update: UPDATE ticket_product_options SET name = #{request.name}, description = #{request.description}, unit_price = #{request.unitPrice}, max_quantity_per_user = #{request.maxQuantityPerUser}, sort_order = #{request.sortOrder}, is_active = #{request.isActive} WHERE ticket_product_option_id = #{optionId}
